items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: Because my grandmother lost a sister doing the yellow fever. Her name was Helena.

ctx.x: They died when they were—they—many people did at that time. That's right, yes.

And then you had yellow fever doing those days. Yeah. Because my grandmother lost a sister doing the yellow fever. Her name was Helena. Mm-hmm. But I don't remember—I don't believe my mother had any children to name but the three that she—that she sang. That's the three, yes, on the 100. And then they didn't know whether I was going to live or not because she was so terribly sick after I was born. That's right. Mm-hmm.
And your grandmother took care of you. Oh, my goodness. Do you remember just which—I mean, no, you wouldn't remember. Nobody remembers where they were born, but I mean, which house were you born in?
